plan.summary: BRO-2740: record a clear on 48 review files that carry stale wrongProduction detector provenance but whose publish date falls inside the production window (detector parsed a stale date, or matched a year in the URL). The flag was already absent, so these score today; the clear stops them reading as orphans and stops the detector re-flagging them. The other 20 baselined files (no date, no url, pre-opening, or already excluded) are left for a human check. (part 1 of 2)
steps: Set wrongProductionManualClear on each file whose publishDate is within 2 days before to 60 days after the show opening date and which has a url and no other exclusion flag.
